metaTitle: Custom Screen Print Headwear | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom screen print headwear for your team or event. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Screen printing on headwear delivers bold, long-lasting logos that stand up to repeated wear and washing. This decoration method works best for simple, two-color designs on structured caps, beanies, and visors. Marketing directors and safety managers choose screen print headwear when they need consistent, vibrant branding across large orders. The ink sits on the fabric surface, creating a crisp, opaque finish that pops on cotton or polyester blends. Perfect for trade shows, uniform programs, and employee giveaways where durability matters.
heroAltText: Custom screen print headwear with bold logos on structured caps for corporate branding
